key_insight: Selective auditing can reduce expert review while provably keeping the fraction of AI errors that escape auditing below a user-defined threshold.
engineering_relevance: AI pipelines can use confidence scores to route decisions to automatic acceptance or expert review while controlling missed errors.
method: Formulate sequential audit decisions as online constrained optimization.
Use proposed decisions and confidence scores, potentially from separate models, to select expert audits.
Provide assumption-free error-control guarantees, with one method asymptotically attaining the optimal auditing rate for adversarial and i.i.d. streams.
evidence_signal: Experiments on harmful-request screening, qualitative text annotation, and data labeling demonstrate valid error control with substantially less human auditing than baselines.
watch_item: The optimal auditing-rate guarantee is asymptotic; finite-run review requirements and the reliability of expert corrections remain deployment considerations.
paper_title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
